elements.name: Shaft and lift landing
elements.about: The top of the shaft that drops 197 ft (60 m) to the service layer: goods lifts, a crew lift and a stair land here.

elements.name: Goods lift cage
elements.about: A lift big enough for a small truck, carrying deliveries and heavy plant up and down.

elements.name: Crew lift and stair
elements.about: The lift and stair maintenance crews use to go down to the service layer.

elements.name: Stairs and lifts
